prompt_en:
Goal: Create a 3x3 cinematic storyboard contact sheet for an animated short reel about a capybara meal-coach helping a woman track dumplings for calories.

Canvas: Landscape 4:3 storyboard sheet, cream paper background, nine equal panels in a 3 columns by 3 rows grid, thin black borders, white caption strips under every frame. Warm cozy evening kitchen setting with olive-green cabinets, tiled backsplash, window with night city lights, pink props, soft practical lamp light, shallow depth of field, polished 3D animated film look.

Main characters: A friendly anthropomorphic capybara coach wearing a black zip hoodie with hot-pink stripes, pink headband, pink whistle on a lanyard, rounded muzzle, calm judging expression. A young woman with messy bright red hair in a loose bun, cream cable-knit sweater, seated at a round wooden kitchen table; her face is intentionally obscured by a flat soft-edged tan/brown square privacy mask in panels where it faces camera. Keep the capybara expressive and readable.

Key props: One large plate of pelmeni dumplings, one pink mug with a pale heart, pink cloth napkins, fork and spoon, a whiteboard on an easel or wall with bold Russian calorie tracking notes, pink marker, small magnets and sticky note, potted plants and kitchen utensils.

Visible storyboard text: Use exactly 9 caption strips, numbered 1 through 9, with timecodes and shot notes in a handwritten storyboard style. The whiteboard must show this Russian text exactly: ПЕЛЬМЕНИ x 5\n= 425 ККАЛ\nДЕФИЦИТ OK ✓. Caption strip text should be legible and similar to: 1. [0:00--0:02] WIDE - Establish - Static - Warm practicals + soft fill; 2. [0:02--0:04] MEDIUM - Reveal - Push in - Backlight + rim; 3. [0:04--0:06] MEDIUM - Judge - Subtle push - Key + rim; 4. [0:06--0:08] CLOSE-UP - Take - Push in - Steam emphasized; 5. [0:08--0:10] OTS - Write - Slight push - Soft key + board glow; 6. [0:10--0:12] MEDIUM - Teach - Pan right - Balanced key + rim; 7. [0:12--0:14] CLOSE-UP - React - Hold - Soft key + catchlight; 8. [0:14--0:16] MEDIUM TWO-SHOT - Share - Static - Warm key + rim; 9. [0:16--0:18] WIDE - Wrap - Slight dolly out - Warm practicals + rim.

Panel-by-panel layout, exactly 9 panels: Panel 1 wide establishing shot: woman alone at table about to eat dumplings, pink mug and napkin visible, green kitchen at night. Panel 2 medium reveal: woman foreground left with spoon, capybara coach appears in a glowing doorway behind her. Panel 3 medium judge: capybara stands beside seated woman, looking sideways at her plate with a suspicious coach expression. Panel 4 close-up: capybara paw uses pink tongs or marker-like utensil to pick one dumpling from steaming plate, woman hands nearby, pink mug left. Panel 5 over-the-shoulder from behind capybara: capybara writes on whiteboard with pink marker while woman watches from side. Panel 6 medium teach: capybara points at the whiteboard text with pink marker while woman listens, with capybara face partly obscured by a tan/brown privacy mask block if facing camera. Panel 7 close-up reaction: woman leaning on clasped hands, red hair filling frame, face covered by tan/brown square mask, cozy kitchen blur behind. Panel 8 medium two-shot: capybara and woman sit together at table sharing dumplings, each holding a dumpling utensil, plate centered, pink bowl and mug visible. Panel 9 wide wrap: both characters at round table in full kitchen, whiteboard visible at right with the calorie note, pendant lamp above, window behind.

Visual style: High-end 3D animated family-film aesthetic, warm cinematic lighting, soft rim lights, subtle bloom, realistic food steam, saturated olive greens and pink accents, consistent character designs across panels, storyboard production-board composition.

Constraints: Include exactly 9 panels and exactly 9 caption strips. Do not add extra characters. Keep all panels coherent as a single timeline reference for video animation. Maintain legible whiteboard text and visible Russian lettering; avoid logos or watermarks.\

title: 《赤壁》空气吉他故事板 - 1
author: @もんなつ SHOWSHOWMOM
categories: 漫画 / 分镜,插画,Q版 / 萌系,草图 / 线稿,角色,文字 / 排版
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a colorful 8-panel storyboard sheet for an animated sequence featuring Souichirock, a chibi punk-rock boy performing an intense invisible air-guitar solo and ending with a dramatic guitar-smash pose.

Canvas: Wide horizontal storyboard image, clean white background, divided into exactly 8 equal rectangular panels arranged in a 2-row by 4-column grid. Use thin light-gray panel borders. Each panel has a small circled black number in the upper-left corner, labeled exactly 1 through 8.

Visual style: Hand-drawn digital illustration with bold black ink outlines, exaggerated manga/chibi proportions, dynamic comic action poses, expressive angry rock-performance face, and high-energy paint-splash effects. Use vivid splashes and sweeping arcs of cyan, magenta, purple, orange, green, blue, and black around the character to visualize the sound and motion of the invisible guitar. Keep the background mostly white and uncluttered.

Character details: The same chibi male character appears in all 8 panels. He has short spiky black hair, pale skin, thick black eyebrows, an open shouting mouth with red interior, and an intense scowling expression. Outfit: short-sleeve cream shirt covered in colorful paint-like marks, black pants, black shoes, black studded wristbands, and a small punk-rock attitude. He does not hold a visible guitar; his hands mime playing and smashing an air guitar.

Panel-by-panel action sequence: Include exactly 8 numbered panels. Panel 1: wide-legged stance, left hand low as if gripping the neck of an invisible guitar, right hand clawing near the body, shouting, with bright paint bursts behind him and blue-magenta arcs sweeping to the right. Panel 2: deeper lunge, legs spread wider, both hands actively strumming and fretting an invisible guitar, a large blue and magenta sound-wave swirl blasting from his right side. Panel 3: centered rock stance, knees bent, left hand extended like a guitar neck, right hand near the torso, shouting toward the viewer, with dense multicolor splatter behind him. Panel 4: leaning far backward to the right, one hand raised in a claw shape and the other near his waist, legs stretched diagonally, with an orange-blue-magenta spiral sweeping around him. Panel 5: crouched low and leaning forward, one knee near the ground, hands in aggressive air-guitar position, surrounded by looping purple, pink, green, and blue paint trails. Panel 6: low lunging pose, body angled forward, one hand reaching down and the other clawed outward, with explosive colorful paint splashes radiating behind him. Panel 7: airborne jump pose, knees bent, one fist raised overhead, mouth wide open in a scream, with vertical motion lines and a rainbow paint arc curving underneath and behind him. Panel 8: final guitar-crash climax, character bent forward with both hands driving downward as if smashing the invisible guitar into the ground, black impact lines and a huge multicolor splatter explosion spreading outward.

Constraints: Use exactly 8 panels and exactly one character per panel. Preserve the small circled panel numbers 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, and 8. No captions other than the panel numbers. Do not add a real guitar, stage, audience, watermark, logo, or extra characters.\

Show a young woman standing in front of a tall rectangular mirror, drawn with loose black sketch lines, messy uneven strokes, and simple flat colors like a casual phone doodle. She has long voluminous wavy dark brown hair, tan skin, gold hoop earrings, a tiny yellow necklace detail, and wears a tight short black sleeveless mini dress with a low neckline. Her face is intentionally hidden by a centered square blur/mosaic block in beige tones. Her left arm is raised holding a large gray smartphone with three black camera lenses, covering part of her face and chest; her right arm hangs down with long fingers and simple nail details. The body proportions are fashion-sketch-like but rough, with exaggerated long legs cropped near mid-thigh at the bottom. Behind her, include a simple bedroom vanity/mirror scene: one large outlined mirror rectangle behind her head and upper body, two yellow lamps on left and right side tables, a sketchy dresser on the right with drawers, a small pink item on top, and rough black furniture lines. Surround the figure with exactly 19 decorative doodles: 5 hearts (pink heart with smiling face in upper left, small black heart near top center, pink heart on left middle, small black heart on right middle, outlined black heart near lower right), 6 stars (yellow star upper left, black star upper right, pink star right of hair, pink star lower left, black star bottom left, yellow sparkle lower right), 3 sparkle marks (yellow rays above mirror, yellow sparkle on right middle, pink sparkle near bottom left), 3 arrows/gesture marks (black rays near phone, large black curved arrow lower left, black arrow pointing up near lower center-right), and 2 scribble clusters (black scribble left middle, pink scribble lower right). Use childlike hand-drawn linework, no realistic rendering, no polished shading, and keep the composition centered like a playful crude doodle based on a mirror selfie. No readable text, no watermark.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a surreal industrial Renaissance collage poster titled MASS PRODUCED AUTHENTICITY, mixing classical sculpture, factory machinery, architectural blueprints, and obsolete computer error imagery into a critical art-print composition.

Canvas: Square poster, 1:1 aspect ratio, aged beige paper background with stains, faint grid lines, registration marks, technical drafting annotations, and a worn archival print texture. Use a muted palette of stone gray, dusty beige, charcoal black, rust orange, faded red, and small accents of Windows-95 blue.

Layout: The upper left contains the main typography: small technical labels reading “SERIES: MPA_001” and “DATE: 05.19.95”, then large elegant serif words “MASS PRODUCED” in dark gray, with the word “AUTHENTICITY” below in tall condensed distressed red-orange type. The left side also includes a small schematic caption block reading “THE ASSEMBLY LINE OF IDENTITY STANDARDIZED, REPLICATED, EMPTY.” followed by “FIG. 07A” and “DAVID PRODUCTION UNIT SCHEMATIC”. The right upper quadrant contains a detailed circular engineering blueprint diagram with measurements and the labels “SECTION A-A” and “SCALE 1:10”. The bottom left contains a small conveyor-belt plan drawing labeled like a technical manufacturing diagram.

Main scene: Across the lower half, show a long conveyor belt receding from left to right, carrying a row of identical classical marble bust heads inspired by Michelangelo’s David. There are exactly 10 visible bust heads arranged along the conveyor, all pale stone with curly Renaissance hair, repeated like factory products. Cover the front faces with exactly 7 opaque gray rectangular censorship blocks of different sizes, aligned over the bust faces: one small block at the far left, two medium blocks left-of-center, one very large vertical block in the center foreground, two medium blocks on the right, and one smaller block near the far right.

Central object: Behind the central bust, a huge pixelated white computer mouse cursor arrow rises diagonally upward, built like a heavy stone or concrete 3D object with dark beveled edges. It is crashing through cracked plaster and rubble, exposing tangled wires, circuit boards, metal components, and broken concrete beneath. Add flying debris and fracture lines around the impact point.

Foreground details: In the lower right foreground, place a rusty red industrial machine housing with chipped paint and black mechanical parts. Overlay a small retro Windows error dialog box tilted slightly, with a blue title bar reading “Error”, a red X icon, the message “Authenticity.exe has stopped working.”, and an “OK” button. On the rusty machine, add black stamped text reading “ERROR”, “CODE: 0x000404”, and “SYSTEM_FAILURE”. Include dark cables, gears, bolts, grime, and orange rust stains spilling into the bottom area.

Visual style: Surreal 404 Renaissance collage, brutalist industrial assemblage, archival blueprint poster, photomontage mixed with engraved technical drawing, distressed printmaking, high-detail textures, cracked stone, exposed electronics, analog paper grain, subtle halftone, museum-conservation beige background, cinematic yet flat editorial composition.

Constraints: Keep all visible text legible and integrated into the print. Use exactly 10 bust heads and exactly 7 gray censorship rectangles. Do not add extra characters, logos, watermarks, modern UI beyond the single retro error dialog, or bright saturated colors outside the small blue error title bar and rust-red typography/machinery.\

title: 动漫AI图像更新横幅

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a high-energy Japanese promotional banner for a tech update about AI image generation, styled like an anime idol rock concert poster.

Canvas: Wide horizontal web banner, 2:1 aspect ratio, approximately 1000×500 px. Use a dense, colorful composition with cinematic lighting, sparkles, stars, lens flares, and a festive concert-stage atmosphere.

Main text: Place large bold Japanese headline text across the top in thick white letters with a heavy black drop shadow: ChatGPTによる画像生成が\n大幅アップデート!. Under it, centered in smaller bold white text with black outline: GPT-Image-2が無料で使える. Make the typography oversized, glossy, and attention-grabbing, occupying the upper third of the banner.

Layout and subjects: Show exactly 5 anime-style band members across the bottom half, arranged left to right:
1. A blue-haired keyboard player on the far left, long blue hair, white blouse, sitting or standing behind a keyboard/synth, face covered by a soft rectangular blur mask.
2. A pink twin-tail idol singer left of center, frilly pink outfit, flower hair accessories, holding a microphone, cheerful expression, fully visible face.
3. A central golden-yellow-haired drummer/front idol, bright yellow cropped jacket and star accessories, holding drumsticks, smiling widely toward the viewer, most prominent character, positioned in front of a drum kit.
4. A dark green-haired bassist/guitarist right of center, black and green outfit, holding a guitar, face covered by a soft rectangular blur mask.
5. A black-haired purple-themed guitarist on the far right, gothic black outfit with straps and accessories, holding a purple electric guitar, face covered by a soft rectangular blur mask.

Background: Put a glowing OpenAI-style knot logo in the center behind the characters, surrounded by a golden circular light halo. Add futuristic monitor panels on both far sides: left monitor with neon interface rings and control panels, right monitor with colorful image-generation style artwork and UI panels. Include stage lights, musical notes, star icons, confetti-like sparkles, bokeh dots, and diagonal light streaks throughout.

Visual style: Vibrant anime illustration, glossy digital art, concert poster energy, saturated pink, gold, purple, and blue palette, dramatic backlighting, high contrast, crisp outlines, polished promotional thumbnail style.

Constraints: Use exactly 5 band members and exactly 2 lines of headline/subtitle text. Keep the Japanese text readable and dominant. Do not add extra logos except the abstract OpenAI-style glowing emblem. No watermark.\

prompt_en: A luminous, ultra-detailed anime-style wedding portrait of two brides in a romantic white chapel filled with soft ivory light, sheer curtains, carved arches, pale floral arrangements, and sparkling bokeh. The composition is vertical and elegant, showing the pair from about thigh-up to full dress detail, standing close together in an intimate yuri moment. The taller bride on the left has warm chestnut brown long wavy hair cascading over her shoulders and back, wearing a refined white bridal pantsuit with a fitted tailcoat, gold buttons, a cream vest, a silk cravat, subtle floral embroidery along the coat tails, and a white rose boutonniere with pale blue accents. She is visibly emotional, gently wiping tears with a handkerchief, her other hand resting near her chest, giving the feeling of being moved by the ceremony. The shorter bride on the right has long black hair, very long and glossy, and wears an ornate off-shoulder wedding gown in white with icy blue undertones, translucent lace sleeves, intricate beadwork, floral embroidery, layered ruffles, and a long veil decorated with tiny flowers and crystal-like details. A silver floral hair ornament with dangling pieces decorates the side of her head. She looks up at her partner tenderly while holding a cascading bouquet of white roses, blue flowers, and trailing greenery. Emphasize the contrast between the tailored princely suit and the delicate fairy-tale gown, with luxurious fabric textures, lace transparency, fine embroidery, soft glowing highlights, drifting sparkles, and a dreamy, emotional atmosphere. Make the scene feel like an original yuri wedding between an older office lady-style bride and a younger nurse-style bride, painted in polished, high-end romantic illustration style, ethereal, graceful, and heartfelt.\
